examples.en: The pilot flew a combat plane.
She has a fighting spirit.
Think positive!
The boss gave my work a positive review.
The doctors cured him.

examples.sr: Ова болест не може да се [излѐчи].
examples.en: This disease can't be cured.
I like the design of this phone.
She studies graphic design.
I've been waiting for you for an eternity!
I will love you forever.
Leave your coat in the cloakroom.
I need a completely new wardrobe.

tips: «Гардероба» is feminine. It also means clothes in general.

examples.en: My neighbor is a Russian from Moscow.
We easily find common ground with Russians.

note: the adjective «руски» is written with a lowercase letter

forms: разболим се, разболе се; impf. разбољевати се

examples.sr: Дете се [разбо̀лело] после купања у реци.
examples.en: The child got sick after swimming in the river.

examples.sr: Обуци се топлије да се не [разбо̀лиш].
examples.en: Dress warmer so you don't get sick.

examples.sr: Наш тим увек [побѐђује] на домаћем терену.
examples.en: Our team always wins at home.
Who is winning the game now?
Give me a clean towel, please.
Don't forget a towel for the beach.
The pain finally eased.
Don't give in to him.
Turn off the TV and go to bed.

examples.sr: Купили смо нови [телѐвӣзор] за дневну собу.
examples.en: We bought a new TV for the living room.
This is the first edition of that book.

examples.sr: Чуо сам то у јутарњем [изда̀њу] вести.
examples.en: I heard it in the morning edition of the news.
That was a brilliant idea of yours!
The party was awesome!

examples.sr: Боксер је ушао у [ри̑нг] уз аплауз.
examples.en: The boxer entered the ring to applause.
The coach was waiting for him by the ring.
She graduated in medicine last year.
What will you do when you graduate?

note: only for university; for school use «завршити»
tips: It means finishing university with a bachelor's degree. For a master's use «магистрирати», for a doctorate «докторирати».

examples.sr: Морамо да [су̀зимо] избор на три кандидата.
examples.en: We have to narrow the choice down to three candidates.
The police narrowed the circle of suspects.
I'm broke again until payday.

examples.sr: Не могу да изађем вечерас, [шво̑рц] сам.
examples.en: I can't go out tonight, I'm broke.

examples.sr: Изашао је [на̏кратко], брзо ће се вратити.
examples.en: He stepped out for a little while, he'll be back soon.
Could I see you for a minute?

tips: Written as one word, it also means «briefly, in a few words»: «Реци ми накратко».

examples.en: There's a grain of truth in every joke.
Birds are pecking at grains on the ground.
Don't touch other people's things.
It's not nice to read other people's letters.
The doors open automatically.
I said it mechanically, without thinking.
I found the apartment through an ad.
She put an ad on the internet.
That's the key question.
He is the key witness in the case.
He's being treated for a gambling addiction.
Dependence on the phone is a serious problem.

examples.sr: Мачка седи на [гра́ни] и не сме да сиђе.
examples.en: The cat is sitting on a branch and is afraid to come down.
Which branch of medicine interests you?
Swallows are building a nest under the roof.
The children left the family nest long ago.

examples.sr: Стани на првој [пу̑мпи], треба нам гориво.
examples.en: Stop at the first gas station, we need fuel.
The water pump has broken down.

tips: Also a gas station: «бензинска пумпа». At the station: «Сипај гориво за три хиљаде динара» - put in three thousand dinars' worth of fuel. The verb «пумпати» means to pump.
«Бензинска пумпа» is a filling station, often shortened to «пумпа». For water and air it is simply a pump.

examples.en: She was shaking out the blanket on the terrace.

examples.sr: Руке су му се [тре́сле] од страха.
examples.en: His hands were shaking with fear.
We watched the sunset by the sea.
We'll be back before sunset.
I don't see the logic in that.
By that logic, we're all to blame.
I work out for an hour every day.
This happens daily.
I bought groceries for the whole week.
This food is rich in vitamins.
Would you like a hot drink?
This drink is alcohol-free.
The news shocked us.

examples.sr: Био сам [шокѝран] кад сам то чуо.
examples.en: I was shocked when I heard it.
We have to consider all the options.
I'll consider your offer by tomorrow.
This is my final decision.
What is the final price?
The prosecutor filed an indictment against him.

examples.sr: У [опту̀жници] се наводе три кривична дела.
examples.en: The indictment lists three criminal offenses.
The countess lived in an old castle.
She behaves like a real countess.
He was released from custody on bail.
We paid a deposit for the apartment in advance.
We visited the Studenica monastery.
Several monks live in the monastery.
I was born in November.
It usually gets cold at the beginning of November.
Put the bags in the trunk.
We have a spare tire in the trunk.
We walked along the quay by the Danube.
Let's meet on the quay at seven.
In the morning the grass is wet with dew.
He walked barefoot in the dew.
He became a vagrant after his divorce.

examples.sr: Пустио је [ски̏тницу] да преноћи у штали.
examples.en: He let the vagrant spend the night in the barn.

note: also used of a man: он је скитница

examples.sr: Не могу да се [концентрѝшем] од буке.
examples.en: I can't concentrate because of the noise.
Concentrate on the road!
The waitress brought us the menu.
She works as a waitress in a café.
There was loud applause after the performance.
Give them a big round of applause!

examples.sr: Погледао је [уо̀коло], али никог није било.
examples.en: He looked around, but there was nobody there.
Don't wander around at night.

examples.sr: Има [у̏палу] плућа и мора да лежи.
examples.en: He has pneumonia and has to stay in bed.

examples.sr: Лекар каже да је то обична [у̏пала] грла.
examples.en: The doctor says it's just a sore throat.

examples.sr: То није ништа у [поређѐњу] са прошлом годином.
examples.en: That's nothing compared to last year.

examples.sr: Да ли имате [до̏ставу] на кућну адресу?
examples.en: Do you deliver to a home address?

examples.sr: [До̏става] је бесплатна за наруџбине преко две хиљаде.
examples.en: Delivery is free for orders over two thousand.

examples.sr: Држао га је на [ни̏шану] све време.

note: a research institute; a university faculty is «факултет»

The guest arrived completely unexpectedly.
It suddenly started to rain.

The concert was incredibly good.

examples.sr: Свака [сли̏чно̄ст] са стварним особама је случајна.
examples.en: Any resemblance to real persons is coincidental.

examples.sr: Министар је [изја̀вио] да неће дати оставку.

examples.sr: Сведок је [изја̀вио] да ништа није видео.

tips: «Припремати се» takes «за» + acc.: «припремам се за испит» - I'm preparing for an exam.

At the till: «Задржите кусур» - keep the change. Do not mix up кусур (change) and кеса (bag): «Задржите кесу» would mean «keep the bag».
«Не треба кусур» or «У реду је» - keep the change.

tips: In everyday speech it is just «даљински», without «управљач»: Где је даљински?

note: a brother's son is also «братанац», a sister's son «сестрић»

tips: Disposable diapers are «пелене за једнократну употребу», cloth ones «тетра пелене». The plural «пелене» is used for both.

tips: «Придржавати се» + gen. means to adhere to, to follow: «придржавати се правила, упутства, савета». On signs: «Придржавајте се прописаних правила» - follow the prescribed rules.

examples.en: Grandpa commanded a division.

meanings: to visit, to drop in on
